mapper.insert: insert into `groupon` (dish_id, leader_user_id, groupon_price, required_size, current_size, status, expire_time, pickup_point_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{dishId}, #{leaderUserId}, #{grouponPrice}, #{requiredSize}, #{currentSize}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{pickupPointId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update `groupon` set current_size = current_size + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{grouponId} and status = 1 and current_size < required_size
